metadata.description: Cell-type and spatial-niche annotation for single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, running entirely in Claude Code with no API key.

plugins.name: lambda-annotate
plugins.description: Annotate cell types and spatial niches in .h5ad datasets. An actor-critic dossier loop reasons over differential expression, cell-type composition and rendered section images; the statistics run locally in the bundled lambdakit engine. No API key required.
